title: Skin-Clinic E-Commerce Homepage
pageOverview: Complete luxury organic skincare DTC brand homepage with hero editorial, product carousels, category spotlights, deep-dive ingredient narratives, dual banner promo cards, testimonials, and newsletter capture.

blocks.title: Header & Primary Navigation Bar
blocks.notes: Minimalist header with brand mark 'Skin—Clinic' centered. Left links: Shop, About us, Journal. Right links: Account, Search, Bag with item count (0).

blocks.title: Hero Editorial Banner
blocks.notes: Full-bleed hero banner featuring shadow play photography of 'Pure Solution Essence'. Eyebrow: 'DISCOVER NATURE'S FINEST INGREDIENTS'. Headline: 'Glow with nature's finest, every single day'. Glassmorphism translucent CTA button 'Shop now'.

blocks.title: Best Sellers Product Carousel
blocks.notes: 4-column product card grid. Products shown: Face Toner ($47.99 with -20% red pill), Body Wash ($49.99), Body Serum ($49.99 with 'New' badge), and Face Mask ($49.99). Displays clean packaging against minimalist off-white pedestal cards.

blocks.title: Shop by Category Cards
blocks.notes: 3 large editorial macro tiles with floating glassmorphism blur pills at bottom: 'Creams' (close-up eye application), 'Serums' (pipette dropper ritual), and 'Lotion' (shoulder dewy application).

blocks.title: Featured Products Carousel
blocks.notes: 4-column curated shelf displaying high-conversion SKUs with compare-at pricing and inventory tags ('-20%', 'New').

blocks.title: Product Deep-Dive & Sheet Mask Feature
blocks.notes: 50/50 split layout. Left: Hand holding 'Dream Peptide Complex Mask' sheet packaging in directional sunlight. Right: Headline 'Hydrate & revitalize with our pure face mask', descriptive copy about natural botanical extracts, and outline CTA 'Shop the face mask'.

blocks.title: Editorial Skincare Journal & Articles
blocks.notes: 3-column skincare advice cards with category pills: 1) 'Tips for a natural skincare routine' (Tags: TIPS, GUIDE), 2) 'Science behind effective face masks' (Tag: SCIENCE), 3) 'Ingredients for glowing skin explained' (Tags: GUIDE, INSIGHT). Clean text link 'Read more'.

blocks.title: Dual Promotional Showcase Banners
blocks.notes: Two side-by-side promotional blocks: Left) Macro dropper bottle with translucent CTA 'Shop the essence'. Right) Warm neutral block with 'Skin—Clinic Gift Card' graphic and outline CTA 'Get a gift card'.

blocks.title: Oceanic Aqua Narrative with Floating Product Card
blocks.notes: Full-width immersive deep-sea blue banner. Eyebrow: 'ESSENCE FOR A BRIGHTER COMPLEXION'. Headline: 'Pure hydration in every drop'. Features an interactive floating glass card on bottom-right embedding the 'Face Toner' ($47.99) with direct quick-add action.

blocks.title: Client Testimonials & Verified Reviews
blocks.notes: 3-column verified client review cards: 1) Sara J. ('Face Toner transformed morning routine'), 2) Helen D. ('Body Serum left skin silky smooth'), 3) Kim W. ('Face Mask is a game-changer'). Each review includes a direct mini thumbnail linking to the product page.

blocks.title: Instagram UGC Social Gallery Grid
blocks.notes: Eyebrow 'FOLLOW US ON INSTAGRAM' and large branding '@Skin—Clinic'. 5-column square grid of close-up skin textures, natural botanicals, facial application, and product swatches.

blocks.title: Newsletter & VIP Lead Capture Banner
blocks.notes: Full-bleed editorial background image of warm interlocking hands. Centered text: 'Subscribe for exclusive deals' with subtitle 'Get exclusive access to the latest natural skincare deals and tips delivered straight to your inbox!' Clean underline email input field with submit arrow.

blocks.title: Global Footer & Navigation Columns
blocks.notes: 4-column clean footer. Left: 'Skin—Clinic' brand logo and social icons (IG, FB, YouTube). Columns: Products (Creams, Serums, Lotions, Shop all), Support (FAQs, Return policy, Shipping policy, Start a return), Company (About us, Journal, Contact us). Bottom: Copyright © 2025 Skin—Clinic, Terms of service, Privacy policy, Cookies settings.
